entities.name: Default bearer context activation procedure
entities.description: Establishes a default EPS bearer context between the UE and the EPC. Initiated by the network in response to PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST from UE. Can be part of attach procedure.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message from UE that triggers the default bearer context activation procedure.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure that may include the default bearer context activation as part of it.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context
entities.description: Bearer context established between UE and EPC without TFT assigned during activation.

entities.name: Traffic Flow Template
entities.description: Template that can be assigned to default EPS bearer after establishment. May be modified by network.

entities.name: Attach procedure failure
entities.description: If attach procedure fails, default bearer activation is considered implicitly failed.

entities.name: Match-all packet filter
entities.description: Property of default EPS bearer context when no TFT is assigned during activation.

relations.description: Default bearer activation procedure is initiated by network in response to PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
Default bearer activation procedure can be part of the attach procedure.
If attach procedure fails, default bearer activation is considered implicitly failed.
Default EPS bearer context does not have TFT assigned during activation, but network may assign/modify TFT later.
Default EPS bearer context without TFT corresponds to using a match-all packet filter.
